name.la: Anonymus Perusinus (De inceptione vel fundamento Ordinis)

description.la: Anonymus Perusinus, De inceptione vel fundamento Ordinis et actibus illorum Fratrum Minorum qui fuerunt primi in religione et socii beati Francisci (c. 1240-1241), a fratre Ioanne, ut videtur, scriptus.
description.en-US: The Anonymous of Perugia, “On the beginning or foundation of the Order and the deeds of those Friars Minor who were first in religion and companions of St. Francis” (c. 1240-1241), probably by Brother John, in Latin. No public-domain English exists.
description.pt-BR: O Anônimo de Perúgia, sobre o início da Ordem e os feitos dos primeiros frades menores (c. 1240-1241).

la.editor: transcription of the critical text of Fontes Franciscani (1995) by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Anonymus Perusinus, poliba.it "Fonti francescane" (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Prologue and chapters. Latin only; the poliba page is the only clean source found.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.
